description: Look up A, AAAA, MX, TXT, NS, CNAME, SOA, CAA, SRV or PTR records of a public name through the Cloudflare and Google public resolvers. Cost: 1 credit per call. Output: JSON. {name, type, status, records:[{type, value, ttl}], count, resolver, elapsed_ms}

all.description: Query the common set (A, AAAA, CNAME, MX, NS, TXT, SOA, CAA) in one call; 'type' is then ignored

name.description: Public hostname, e.g. example.com (internationalised names are converted to punycode). For type PTR: an IPv4/IPv6 address or a complete in-addr.arpa / ip6.arpa name.

name: dns_lookup
title: DNS record lookup
